morgan: FYI saw intermittent p95 spikes in eu after hotpatch at ~02:12 UTC. Not widespread errors but user-facing latency on /v1/chat. Recommend gating EU change windows and preventing rollout until we validate the hotpatch.

deploybot: ACTION: release-queue PAUSED by morgan at 3423456789. Scope: region=eu. Hold ID: HLD-3423.

ops_rita: investigating. Hotpatch touched connection pooling and small allocator flags. Rolling back allocator tweak on 2 nodes to compare. ETA 18m.

dev_ana: please don't auto-rollback full release yet. Suggest pin current canary v4.0.1 and reroute new releases to non-eu regions for the next slot. Also prepare rollback to v4.0.0 if behavior persists.

pm_lin: agree. I'll update release notes and customer comms with a short explanation once we confirm. Also scheduling a deferred slot: move EU slot from 2026-03-27T03:00Z -> 2026-03-27T15:00Z.

morgan: pin command: `./ops/pin_release --region eu --version v4.0.1 --reason "hotpatch hold"`

deploybot: OK pinned v4.0.1 in eu. Requeue command accepted: `/requeue --slot eu-early --new-start 2026-03-27T15:00Z --note "deferred after hotpatch"`

ops_rita: comparator results: nodes with allocator tweak rolled back show p95 normalizing; nodes with tweak still elevated ~20% over baseline. Continuing narrow rollback for remaining nodes.

dev_ana: good signal. If stable in 20m we do a staggered restart: canary -> 10% -> 30% -> full with smoke check `smoke.check('/v1/chat', p95<1.1*baseline)` between steps.

pm_lin: made a short customer-facing note: "EU change window deferred; investigating a transient performance regression after a hotpatch. No action required." Posting to #customers-notify after ops greenlight.

deploybot: REMINDER: hold HLD-3423 expires at 3423456970. Use `/hold extend HLD-3423 --minutes 30` to extend.

morgan: extending for 30m `/hold extend HLD-3423 --minutes 30`

ops_rita: will update in 20m with metrics.

pm_lin: PM stub PM-3423 created. We'll attach timeline and logs after resolution. :thumbsup:
